data.title: A new thread in Thai heritage
data.description: Thailand’s textile heritage took centre stage at the Authors’ Lounge of the Mandarin Oriental, Bangkok, where 27 international delegates of Miss International Queen 2026 stepped onto the runway in contemporary interpretations of royal Thai costumes.

data.title: Wars pose a test as India hosts Brics summit
data.description: NEW DELHI - India will host leaders including the presidents of Russia and Iran for a Brics summit on Saturday, with wars in the Middle East and Ukraine, as well as economic challenges, to dominate talks among the 11-member group.

data.title: Thailand Coaching Summit to explore human roles in AI era
data.description: The Thailand Coaching Summit 2026 will bring together leading executives, organisational development professionals and coaching experts to explore the evolving role of coaching leadership, human-AI collaboration and sustainable high-performance cultures. Taking place on Nov 11 at Thammasat Association, Bangkok, the summit will be held under the theme “Building a Coaching Culture for Modern Organizations.”

data.title: Phuket protest against Jewish New Year event going ahead
data.description: PHUKET - A local civic group is going ahead with its planned demonstration on Friday against a Jewish New Year celebration, despite organisers scaling back the event amid security concerns.

data.title: Sri Lankan monk sent back to jail as pardon revoked
data.description: COLOMBO - Sri Lanka’s Supreme Court overturned Thursday a presidential pardon granted to a hardline nationalist Buddhist monk and ordered him to serve the remainder of a six-year prison sentence for intimidating the wife of a missing cartoonist.

data.title: BMW Group Thailand, Master Car Rental prep 250+ vehicles for major international conference
data.description: Bangkok. BMW Group Thailand, in partnership with Master Car Rental, operating as SIXT Thailand, announced a significant collaboration to prepare and provide a premium fleet of over 250 BMW vehicles to the Ministry of Finance. These vehicles will serve as the official mobility fleet for world leaders and delegates attending a major international conference later this year.

data.title: Nok Krasip connects small traders with AI tools and bank loans
data.description: Nok Krasip links AI sales tools with bank loans, including up to THB500,000 for small traders and a separate SME option offering up to THB3 million.

data.title: Indian trailblazer seeks Asian Games weightlifting glory
data.description: NEW DELHI - Indian weightlifter Mirabai Chanu says she “will not let go” of the chance to round off a glittering career with an elusive Asian Games medal, saying her goal feels “so close”.

data.title: Police gunman surrenders after overnight house siege
data.description: CHON BURI - The policeman who shot his teacher wife to death at a kindergarten on Wednesday has surrendered after an overnight siege at his house in Bang Lamung district.

data.title: Mount Fuji hiking season ends with landslide, rescues
data.description: TOKYO - A landslide struck a car park on Mount Fuji, with the final day of the volcano’s summer climbing season on Thursday marred by downpours and dense mist.

data.title: Sondhi rally delivers pointed anti-Israel message
data.description: Veteran activist Sondhi Limthongkul on Thursday rallied supporters outside the Israeli Embassy in Bangkok, where he called on Israel to monitor the behaviour of its citizens in Thailand, cooperate with investigations into Chabad centres and land ownership, and end military violence against civilians in Gaza.

data.title: Public Health Ministry & MSD Partner to Advance Thailand’s Medical Hub Vision
data.description: Bangkok, Thailand,9September2026 –The Ministry of Public Health (MoPH) and MSD (Thailand) Ltd. today signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on “Health Ecosystem Collaboration to Support theHealthEconomy” to advance Thailand’s Medical Investment Hub policy and translate strategic policy priorities into tangible partnerships and investments.

data.title: Serenity Wines Asia Named Exclusive Thailand Distributor for Spanish Brands BERONIA & VILARNAU
data.description: BANGKOK, Thailand –  Serenity Wines Asia, an Australian wine company and premium international wine importer and distributor in Thailand, has announced a new partnership with renowned Spanish winebrands  BERONIA  and VILARNAU , strengthening its portfolio of carefully selected wines from distinguished producers around the world.To mark the partnership,  Anthony Rossi , Managing Director of Serenity Wines Asia, and  Xavier Vicente Tamames , Asia Pacific& Middle EastExport Director of GonzálezByass, jointly hosted the launch of  “BERONIA & VILARNAU” ,an exclusive wine tasting and celebrationat ElTapeo,Ekkamai, Bangkok.

data.title: Ayutthaya abbot held in embezzlement and sex scandal
data.description: A 66-year-old abbot accused of embezzling 92 million baht from a well-known temple in Ayutthaya was arrested on Thursday, along with a female aide who was seen having sex with the monk in security video taken in his quarters.

data.title: Philippine ferry fire kills at least five, dozens missing
data.description: MANILA - At least five people were killed and 86 remain missing after a fire erupted aboard a ferry near a tourist hotspot in the Philippine province of Palawan, the coast guard said Thursday.

data.title: Var Group Expands Cybersecurity Across Asia Pacific with New Regional Hub in Bangkok
data.description: Bangkok was chosen as regional hub for Yarix APAC and Var Group’s cybersecurity expansion across Asia Pacific

data.title: Thailand advances genomics and AI for equitable breast cancer care
data.description: BANGKOK, Sept 9, 2026 – Cancer specialists, academics, policymakers and patient representatives exchanged perspectives during the panel discussion, “The End of One-Size-Fits-All: Personalising Breast Cancer Care in Thailand: From Genomics to AI-Enabled Care,” at Techsauce Global Summit 2026.

data.title: Bayeux Tapestry ‘mania’ sweeps UK
data.description: LONDON - London’s sold-out Bayeux Tapestry exhibition will open on Thursday to a British public gripped by “mania” as the mediaeval artwork depicting the Norman conquest of England goes on display outside France for the first time.

data.title: Bhumjaithai slams march to pressure EC on Senate case
data.description: The Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) has questioned the appropriateness of People's Party (PP) leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut leading a march to pressure the Election Commission (EC) ahead of its decision on the alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election.

data.title: Evacuations in Malibu as sinkhole opens at Nicolas Cage’s house
data.description: LOS ANGELES - People living in an upmarket coastal stretch of Malibu were under an evacuation order on Wednesday after a giant sinkhole opened up on the driveway of a beachfront home belonging to Oscar-winning US actor Nicolas Cage.

data.title: Rybakina books US Open semi-final against Gauff
data.description: NEW YORK - Elena Rybakina ended Zheng Qinwen’s spirited US Open run on Wednesday, guaranteeing her rise to world No. 1 as she booked a semi-final showdown with Coco Gauff.

data.title: Online and undercover: saving trafficked wildlife in Thailand
data.description: BANGKOK - Nawee Changpirom has spent years working to rescue trafficked wildlife in Thailand, but even he can sometimes hardly believe the creatures he has found: leopards, hornbills, and once an anteater.

data.title: Myanmar tin mega-mine restarts operations
data.description: YANGON - One of the world’s biggest tin mines, located in an autonomous region of war-torn Myanmar, is resuming operations suspended since 2023 and ramping up exports to China, a think tank said on Thursday.

data.title: Defiant Trump promises ‘surge’ in November polls
data.description: DALLAS - A defiant Donald Trump has vowed Republicans would “surge forward” in November’s midterm elections, seeking to rally his party against grim poll forecasts, weak approval ratings and mounting voter discontent over prices and his war with Iran.

data.title: August ‘hottest month ever recorded globally’
data.description: PARIS - August was the hottest single month ever recorded globally, with ocean temperatures also reaching unprecedented highs as western Europe capped its warmest summer, the EU’s climate monitor said on Thursday.

data.title: Jewish New Year event in Phuket triggers warning
data.description: PHUKET: Authorities have raised security and tourism-image concerns over a planned Jewish New Year, or Rosh Hashanah, celebration at Chabad House Patong on Friday.

data.title: Blackchin tilapia now in Northeast
data.description: Kalasin has confirmed the first discovery of blackchin tilapia in the Northeast, prompting urgent efforts to contain the invasive species, which threatens 2 billion baht in annual aquaculture production.

data.title: Chinese financiers face arrest warrants
data.description: Police are preparing to seek arrest warrants within two weeks for Chinese financiers allegedly linked to an illegal timber network operating in northern Thailand.
